summary: Extends RESTCONF (RFC 8040) so it works with the Network Management Datastore Architecture from RFC 8342. It adds new datastore resources, a new query parameter, and requires servers that support the architecture to use the YANG library. It updates RFC 8040 and is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: Imagine a control panel for a machine that used to show only one set of settings. This update adds more panels, such as saved settings and live settings, so a remote operator can look at each one separately.
